question: A 100-mm prick punch with a 7-mm diameter body could have a 2.5-mm diameter point ground to an angle of_______.
solution:
The correct answer is __30°__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A prick punch__ is a layout tool used to create small indentation marks on workpieces.
 
• The angle of the point is an important parameter for accurate marking.
 
• For this particular case, the angle of the point is __30°__, as it is suitable for precision work.
 
• Other angles, such as 45°, 90°, or 120°, are used for different applications but are not ideal in this scenario.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Prick Punch Usage:**

 
 
• It is used to transfer dimensions from a drawing to the workpiece for machining or drilling.
 
• The indentation created helps to guide drill bits and prevent slipping.
 
 
 
• **Angle Selection:**
 
 
• A 30° angle__ is ideal for creating sharp and precise marks on the surface.
 
• Larger angles, such as __90° or 120°__, are typically used in center punches for guiding large drills.
